# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

We want participation in this project to be respectful and free of
harassment. Contributors and maintainers should treat each other with
professionalism and good faith.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful of differing viewpoints and experience levels.
- Give constructive, specific feedback.
- Assume good intent, but correct problems directly.
- Keep discussions focused on the project and its users.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, threats, or personal attacks.
- Discriminatory language or conduct.
- Publishing private information without permission.
- Sustained disruption of discussions or project work.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove comments, close discussions, or block accounts that
violate this code. Reports can be sent through the repository's private
security advisory channel or directly to the maintainers. Reports will be
reviewed in good faith and handled as privately as practical.

## Scope

This code applies to project spaces, issue trackers, pull requests,
discussions, and other official project communication channels.

## Attribution

This is a short project-specific code of conduct. It is not legal advice.
